file /proj/Bars.arrangements.lua (w) <<
-- REAPER Arrangements. Each entry is an ordered list of Region Names.
-- `headroom` adjusts a region's end, in seconds; 0 leaves it alone, and the
-- new end is always rounded to the nearest bar line. Shrinking may only ever
-- remove silence -- a run refuses rather than cutting into a region's content.
-- Edit freely; this file is read in a sandbox and validated on load.
return {
  ["Ghost"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Zulu", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Headroom"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = 4 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Identity"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = 0 },
    { "Charlie", headroom = 0 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Reordered"] = {
    { "Charlie", headroom = 0 },
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Shrink"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = -20 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Subset"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = 0 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
  },
}
>>

ShowMessageBox("Apply Arrangement", 0) -> 1 <<
Applied "Identity": 3 region(s), 1 marker(s), 3 tempo marker(s), 1 envelope point(s) and 3 item(s) moved, 3 cut(s) made.

1 Tempo Anchor(s) were written at region starts (3 of 4 region(s) already had one with the right values), so each region carries its own bar grid regardless of what a Repack puts in front of it.

2 region(s) were PADDED to the next bar line, adding 2.000s of silence inside their bounds -- permanently, and this does not happen again on a later Repack:
  Bravo (+1.000s)
  Delta (+1.000s)

8 automation anchor(s) were written at region bounds, so each region keeps its own automation values instead of inheriting its new neighbour's. They are listed in the run log.

4 piece(s) of material and 1 envelope point(s) touching no region were DISCARDED. They are listed in the run log beside the project; Undo restores them.
>>
